desc: Implement single-pass simultaneous residue DP (cnt arrays for d=1..9, shift residue (10r+c)%d, add one-char substring, count when c==d) in Solution.countSubstrings
Validate the implementation against the three provided examples (expect 11, 18, 25)
Validate against a brute-force O(n^2) reference on many random small strings, including leading zeros and single non-zero digits
Confirm complexity ~O(45n)/O(45) space for n up to 10^5 and optimize Python constant factors if needed
